---
title: "System Status"
---

<img src="images/main_logo.png" class="centered-image">

## Current Status

<!-- 1. UNIFIED REAL-TIME TELEMETRY WIDGET -->
<div id="api-status-widget" style="background: #f8f9fa; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; border-left: 4px solid #28a745; padding: 15px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: monospace; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; margin: 20px 0;">
  <div><strong>Status:</strong> <span id="w-status" style="color: #28a745; font-weight: bold;">Operational</span></div>
  <div><strong>Active Links:</strong> <span id="w-links">...</span></div>
  <div><strong>Stations Heard via RF (last 4 hours):</strong> <span id="w-rf">...</span></div>
  <div><strong>Stations Heard via AXIP (last 4 hours):</strong> <span id="w-axip">...</span></div>
  <div><strong>Last Packet:</strong> <span id="w-last">...</span></div>
</div>

<div id="api-status" style="display:none;"></div>

<hr>

## Activity Feed
<div id="activity-feed-container" style="background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dee2e6; padding: 15px; border-radius: 4px; font-family: monospace; max-height: 200px; overflow-y: auto; line-height: 1.4; color: #333;">
  <p style="color: #666; font-style: italic;">Parsing real-time event logs...</p>
</div>

<hr>

## Live Links
<div id="links-container">
  <p>Loading active network link matrix...</p>
</div>

<hr>

## Live MHeard
<div id="mheard-container">
  <p>Loading recently heard packet history...</p>
</div>

<hr>

## Network Routing Nodes

<div style="margin-bottom: 15px;">
  <input type="text" id="node-search" placeholder="🔍 Search nodes by callsign or alias..." style="width: 100%; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 1em;">
</div>

<div id="nodes-container" style="max-height: 400px; overflow-y: auto; border: 1px solid #eee; padding: 10px; border-radius: 4px; background: #fafafa;">
  <p>Loading routing node index...</p>
</div>

<script>
let allNodes = [];

async function fetchDashboardData() {
  const wStatus = document.getElementById("w-status");
  const wLinks = document.getElementById("w-links");
  const wRf = document.getElementById("w-rf");
  const wAxip = document.getElementById("w-axip");
  const wLast = document.getElementById("w-last");
  const wBox = document.getElementById("api-status-widget");

  const feedEl = document.getElementById("activity-feed-container");
  const linksEl = document.getElementById("links-container");
  const mheardEl = document.getElementById("mheard-container");
  const nodesEl = document.getElementById("nodes-container");

  const base = "https://gb7cam.org.uk";

  try {
    const [linksRes, mheardRes, nodesRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(base + "/links"),
      fetch(base + "/mheard"),
      fetch(base + "/nodes")
    ]);

    if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok || !nodesRes.ok) throw new Error("API broken");

    const linksData = await linksRes.json();
    const mheardData = await mheardRes.json();
    const nodesData = await nodesRes.json();

    const activeLinksList = linksData.links || [];
    const mheardList = mheardData.mheard || [];
    allNodes = nodesData.nodes || [];

    // 1. ACTIVITY FEED
    let timelineEvents = [];

    activeLinksList.forEach(link => {
      const stateLabel = (link.state && link.state.toUpperCase() === "ESTABLISHED") ? "Link up" : "Link down";
      const color = stateLabel === "Link up" ? "#2e7d32" : "#c62828";
      timelineEvents.push({
        timeSort: Date.now(),
        html: '<div style="margin-bottom:4px;">⏱️ [Live State] <span style="color:' + color + '; font-weight:bold;">' + stateLabel + ': ' + link.farCall + '</span> (Port ' + link.port + ')</div>'
      });
    });

    mheardList.forEach(st => {
      let rawTime = st.lastHeard;
      if (rawTime && !rawTime.endsWith('Z') && !rawTime.includes('+')) rawTime += 'Z';
      const parsedTime = Date.parse(rawTime);
      if (!isNaN(parsedTime)) {
        const hhmm = new Date(parsedTime).toISOString().substring(11, 16);
        timelineEvents.push({
          timeSort: parsedTime,
          html: '<div style="margin-bottom:4px;">🕒 ' + hhmm + ' <span style="color:#1565c0; font-weight:bold;">Heard ' + st.callSign + '</span> on Port ' + st.port + '</div>'
        });
      }
    });

    timelineEvents.sort((a, b) => b.timeSort - a.timeSort);
    if (timelineEvents.length === 0) {
      feedEl.innerHTML = "<p style='color:#666;'>No recent system events logged.</p>";
    } else {
      feedEl.innerHTML = timelineEvents.map(e => e.html).join("");
    }

    // 2. LIVE LINKS
    linksEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (activeLinksList.length === 0) {
      linksEl.innerHTML = "<p>No active connections reported.</p>";
    } else {
      let outLinks = [];
      outLinks.push('<table class="table table-hover" style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:10px;">');
      outLinks.push('<thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #ccc; text-align:left;">');
      outLinks.push('<th style="padding:8px;">Remote Node</th><th style="padding:8px;">Local Port</th>');
      outLinks.push('<th style="padding:8px;">Type</th><th style="padding:8px;">Status / Mode</th></tr></thead><tbody>');
      activeLinksList.forEach(link => {
        const isUp = link.state && link.state.toUpperCase() === "ESTABLISHED";
        const bg = isUp ? "#d4edda" : "#f8d7da";
        const tc = isUp ? "#155724" : "#721c24";
        outLinks.push('<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">');
        outLinks.push('<td style="padding:8px; font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50;">' + link.farCall + '</td>');
        outLinks.push('<td style="padding:8px;">Port ' + link.port + '</td>');
        outLinks.push('<td style="padding:8px; font-size:0.9em; color:#666;">' + (link.linkType || "AXUDP") + '</td>');
        outLinks.push('<td style="padding:8px;"><span style="background-color:' + bg + '; color:' + tc + '; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:4px; font-size:0.9em; font-weight:bold;">' + (link.state || "ACTIVE") + '</span></td></tr>');
      });
      outLinks.push('</tbody></table>');
      linksEl.innerHTML = outLinks.join('');
    }

    // 3. LIVE MHEARD
    mheardEl.innerHTML = "";
    if (mheardList.length === 0) {
      mheardEl.innerHTML = "<p>No stations logged in buffer.</p>";
    } else {
      let outHeard = [];
      outHeard.push('<table class="table table-hover" style="width:100%; border-collapse:collapse; margin-top:10px;">');
      outHeard.push('<thead><tr style="border-bottom:2px solid #ccc; text-align:left;">');
      outHeard.push('<th style="padding:8px;">Callsign</th><th style="padding:8px;">Port Connection</th>');
      outHeard.push('<th style="padding:8px;">Packets Exchanged</th><th style="padding:8px;">Last Heard (UTC)</th></tr></thead><tbody>');
      mheardList.forEach(st => {
        const pNum = Number(st.port);
        const portFriendly = pNum === 1 ? "Port 1 (RF)" : pNum === 3 ? "Port 3 (AXIP)" : "Port " + pNum;
        const callColor = pNum === 1 ? "#2e7d32" : "#1565c0";
        let rawTime = st.lastHeard;
        if (rawTime && !rawTime.endsWith('Z') && !rawTime.includes('+')) rawTime += 'Z';
        const displayTime = !isNaN(Date.parse(rawTime)) ? new Date(rawTime).toISOString().substring(11, 16) + " UTC" : st.lastHeard;
        outHeard.push('<tr style="border-bottom:1px solid #eee;">');
        outHeard.push('<td style="padding:8px; font-weight:bold; color:' + callColor + ';">' + st.callSign + '</td>');
        outHeard.push('<td style="padding:8px; font-weight:500;">' + portFriendly + '</td>');
        outHeard.push('<td style="padding:8px;">' + Number(st.packets).toLocaleString() + '</td>');
        outHeard.push('<td style="padding:8px; color:#555;">' + displayTime + '</td></tr>');
      });
      outHeard.push('</tbody></table>');
      mheardEl.innerHTML = outHeard.join('');
    }

    // 4. METRICS
    wLinks.innerText = activeLinksList.length;
    let rfCount = 0, axipCount = 0, latestTimestamp = 0, latestCallsign = "None";
    const fourHoursAgo = Date.now() - (4 * 60 * 60 * 1000);

    mheardList.forEach(st => {
      let rawTime = st.lastHeard;
      if (rawTime && !rawTime.endsWith('Z') && !rawTime.includes('+')) rawTime += 'Z';
      const parsedTime = Date.parse(rawTime);
      if (!isNaN(parsedTime)) {
        if (parsedTime > latestTimestamp) {
          latestTimestamp = parsedTime;
          latestCallsign = st.callSign || "Unknown";
        }
        if (parsedTime >= fourHoursAgo) {
          if (Number(st.port) === 1) rfCount++;
          else if (Number(st.port) === 3) axipCount++;
        }
      }
    });

    wRf.innerText = rfCount;
    wAxip.innerText = axipCount;

    if (latestTimestamp > 0) {
      const diffMins = Math.max(0, Math.floor((Date.now() - latestTimestamp) / 60000));
      if (diffMins < 1) wLast.innerText = latestCallsign + " - Just now";
      else if (diffMins < 60) wLast.innerText = latestCallsign + " - " + diffMins + " mins ago";
      else wLast.innerText = latestCallsign + " - " + Math.floor(diffMins / 60) + " hours ago";
    } else {
      wLast.innerText = "No recent data";
    }

    wStatus.innerText = "Operational";
    wStatus.style.color = "#28a745";
    wBox.style.borderLeftColor = "#28a745";
    renderNodes(allNodes);

  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Dashboard loop error:", error);
    wStatus.innerText = "Under Maintenance";
    wStatus.style.color = "#dc3545";
    wBox.style.borderLeftColor = "#dc3545";
    wLinks.innerText = "—"; wRf.innerText = "—"; wAxip.innerText = "—"; wLast.innerText = "Offline";
    const errHtml = "<p style='color:#721c24; background-color:#f8d7da; padding:10px; border-radius:4px;'>Server telemetry stream unreachable.</p>";
    feedEl.innerHTML = errHtml; linksEl.innerHTML = errHtml; mheardEl.innerHTML = errHtml; nodesEl.innerHTML = errHtml;
  }
}

function renderNodes(nodesList) {
  const nodesEl = document.getElementById("nodes-container");
  if (nodesList.length === 0) {
  nodesEl.innerHTML = "No matching network nodes indexed.";
  return;
}

  let outNodes = [];
  outNodes.push('<div style="display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap:10px; padding:5px;">');
  
  nodesList.forEach(node => {
    const aliasText = node.Alias ? '<span style="color:#e67e22; font-size:0.9em;">:' + node.Alias + '</span>' : '';
    const rCount = node.Routes ? node.Routes.length : 0;
    
    outNodes.push('<div style="background:white; border:1px solid #e2e8f0; padding:8px 12px; border-radius:4px; box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.02);">');
    outNodes.push('<div style="font-weight:bold; color:#2c3e50; font-size:1.05em;">' + node.Call + aliasText + '</div>');
    outNodes.push('<div style="font-size:0.85em; color:#7f8c8d; margin-top:4px;">🗺️ Routes: <strong>' + rCount + '</strong></div></div>');
  });
  
  outNodes.push('</div>');
  nodesEl.innerHTML = outNodes.join('');
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchDashboardData();
  setInterval(fetchDashboardData, 60000);
  
  document.getElementById("node-search").addEventListener("input", (e) => {
    const term = e.target.value.toUpperCase().trim();
    const filtered = allNodes.filter(n => 
      n.Call.toUpperCase().includes(term) || (n.Alias && n.Alias.toUpperCase().includes(term))
    );
    renderNodes(filtered);
  });
});
</script>
